svg.title: Three money records, three different meanings: Bohemia 2004 and 2005
svg.desc: Original source-based infographic comparing a $600,000 Haspel and Davis court-registry deposit the Orleans Levee District reported for February 26, 2004, a distinct $314,491.59 payment reported in the Lemona H. Chandler case, and a $456,190 escrow reserve shown on the June 30, 2005 balance sheet. A 2010 authority resolution calls the $600,000 transfer February 27, one day later. Neither the court-registry deposit nor reserved balance independently proves individual heir receipt; the Chandler case payment is reported by the district, not independently traced to a cleared recipient account.

svg.text: Three money records. Three different meanings.
Bohemia Spillway · Orleans Levee District FY2005 audited financial statements
Do not add these figures together.
Different cases, different accounting stages, and no reconciled beneficiary-level ledger.
Sources: FY2005 audited accounts, notes 14 & 17, pp. 61 & 64 · 2010 flood-authority Resolution 02-18-10-08
